features.quote: cap max turns (spirals are cheap to detect early — most signal is in the first 15–20 turns; a hard cap at 25–30 saves the long tails)

keep the deception *task-internal* (broken harness) rather than building tasks that train the model to distrust legitimate system instructions — you don't want to accidentally select for paranoia about real tool feedback.
features.justification_quote: you don't want to accidentally select for paranoia about real tool feedback

features.quote: Don't let this eval become a training target naively. If it gets optimized against, the cheapest way to pass is to make the model stubbornly persistent on impossible tasks and tonally flat — which degrades real reliability
features.justification_quote: degrades real reliability (a model that never says 'this is broken' is worse, not better)
